timeUnits: seconds of production RunTime; observedElapsed also includes bot menu frames
strategy: bot: viewport-visible missing-material drops first; native FindPath45 replanned at most every .5s; fixed reference patrol targets; eight camera-relative movement directions; pre-AoE 300-500cm band and dodge below160; post-AoE 140-180cm band and emergency dodge below90; first upgrade option; ready reaction at least .25 observed seconds; production Action menus are fast bot actions, not physical keyboard or human reaction. No teleport, clear, HP, resource, probability, timer or wave overrides.
firstAnyMeaning: first ordinary material observed entering Inventory; fieldAvailable includes reachable offscreen drops and is not HUD readiness
samplingNote: ground/field first times are sampled every .25 observed seconds plus frame quantization; inventory is checked every helper tick; HUD text comes from the previous rendered frame. firstFieldAvailable requires all three at the same sample, not the max of historical first times. Equal seeds across viewports do not imply identical drop sequences.
